name: Base44
description: Create, edit, and manage Base44 apps directly from Claude. Describe what you want to build and Base44 will generate a full-stack project for you — with data models, backend logic, and a working UI. Query your app's data, update entity schemas, and iterate on existing projects without ever leaving Claude. Make Base44 a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered app builder that turns ideas into production-ready apps, faster.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Base44 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Base44 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.base44.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Base44 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Base44 provides these MCP tools: create_base44_app, edit_base44_app, list_user_apps, list_entity_schemas, and query_entities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Base44?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Base44 in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Base44 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Base44 is developed by Base44. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
